storage.guidance_subtitle: Scientifically verified storage requirements to minimize post-harvest spoilage
storage.guidance_chawl_desc: Essential for storage onions! Bulbs contain ~85% water. Standard refrigerated cold storage without dehumidification causes skin peeling and black mold (Aspergillus niger). Bottom-draft naturally ventilated chawls maintain dry ambient air circulation.
storage.guidance_cold_desc: Maintains 0°C to 4°C at 95% relative humidity. Excellent for potatoes, grapes, pomegranate, apples, and carrots. Strictly incompatible with standard bulk onions unless equipped with specialized dehumidified CA chambers.
storage.guidance_godown_desc: Dry, rodent-proof ambient warehouse certified under WDRA. Ideal for bagged grains, pulses, soyabean, and cotton. Not suited for bulk perishable onion bulbs without aeration crates.
storage.guidance_sources_note: References: ICAR-Directorate of Onion and Garlic Research (DOGR), Rajgurunagar, Pune & National Horticulture Board (NHB) Post-Harvest Standards.

about.philosophy_quote: "We don't optimize for the highest predicted price. We help farmers make informed decisions about their expected net income."
about.philosophy_desc: In agriculture, price alone is a deceptive metric. A price that rises ₹300 per quintal over two months sounds appealing, but if the farmer loses 8% of the harvest to weight shrinkage, pays ₹90 in storage fees, and incurs secondary transit costs, the net cash in their pocket may actually decline. SevaSathi restores transparent arithmetic to the farmer.
about.dilemma_intro: Maharashtra accounts for over 40% of India's annual onion production. Growers around Lasalgaon, Pimpalgaon, and Pune face severe post-harvest vulnerabilities:
about.dilemma_1_desc: During peak harvest windows, daily arrivals exceed thousands of tonnes, collapsing farmgate prices.
about.dilemma_2_desc: Farmers must pay debts and buy seasonal inputs immediately, forcing distress sales.
about.dilemma_3_desc: Onions shrink and spoil in storage. Without transparent calculations, storage costs can exceed price gains.
about.dilemma_4_desc: SevaSathi's Strategy C calculates precisely how much produce must be sold today to fulfill cash needs, while preserving the surplus in nearby verified ventilated chawls.
about.sources_desc: SevaSathi maintains strict data provenance boundaries. Individual storage facilities, statewise aggregates, and daily mandi observations belong to different grains and are never falsely combined.
about.transparency_notice_desc: In accordance with strict hackathon principles, SevaSathi avoids fabricated testimonials, fake user counters, and false verification claims. Unverified rates and capacities are reported as 'Not provided' rather than guessing. Prototype price forecasts use statistical trend modeling and are clearly labeled as SIMULATED DEMO DATA until connected to live OGD India API keys.
about.source_1_desc: Official Directorate of Marketing & Inspection wholesale price records
about.source_2_desc: Warehousing Development Regulatory Authority and National Horticulture Board facilities
about.source_3_desc: Zero black-box logic; pure net income formulas with transparent assumptions
